commands.name: file_list
commands.description: Lists the files and folders directly in a folder, by name, leaving out hidden ones.

args.name: folder
args.meaning: An absolute path, or one starting with ~.

args.name: limit
args.meaning: The most items to return.

args.name: fields
args.meaning: Fields to return, as a comma-separated string or a list; adds created_date if asked.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "background": this command has no verified ui mode.

commands.precondition: The program can read the folder; macOS may ask once for protected folders.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: nothing exists at the path, or the folder is missing; nothing is changed

errors.name: OutsideAllowedRoot
errors.when: FINDER_ALLOWED_ROOT is set and a path is outside it; nothing is done

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "ui": this command only reads, and has no verified ui mode

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
Only touches what FINDER_ALLOWED_ROOT allows if it is set; if it isn't set, any path you can reach is accepted.
